Getter correctly fetches '/home/user/Desktop/resized.png' and reads its dimensions via PIL, directly verifying the image resize requirement.
Metric correctly checks if any extension line contains 'lisp' (case-insensitive) for the Lisp extension sub-goal (+0.5).
Metric correctly compares image width and height against expected 128x128 for the resize sub-goal (+0.5).
Both instruction requirements (Lisp extension install, image resize to 128x128 on Desktop) are fully covered with appropriate partial-credit scoring.
Expected parameter handling is correct: with expected.type='rule', the framework passes rules dict directly; metric uses expected.get('width', 128) which is the correct access pattern.
No postconfig needed: extension list retrieval and file access do not depend on any open dialog or UI state.
